author: MasterProX
body:
Usernames  —  Motofreak10, jakeyminecraft
Offense  —  Excessive bullying and harassment through spammed chat messages.
Evidence  —  http://imageshack.com/a/img538/7451/bIWxuk.png
http://imageshack.com/a/img540/4217/MJHTSZ.png

This actually persisted for several minutes encompassing two successive games that happened about half an hour ago now. The two of them became arrogant after killing me and continued to pester me incessantly in the chat, which in turn led to others imitating them and heckling me as well. As far as I'm aware, those who copied them have already been dealt with (by Cupcake, I believe) or voluntarily stopped. The two offenders' infractions pages also show that this is not their first time exhibiting bad sportsmanship, so that should be kept in mind when punishing them... if any further evidence is needed, I have the full chat logs (in raw form as they appear in the Minecraft files) as well as several witnesses who may also have screenshots.
